content.short: Foundation Capital is a 30-year-old venture firm investing in infrastructure problems to onboard the next billion crypto users.
content.description: Foundation Capital is an early-stage venture capital firm focused on fintech, enterprise, and consumer investments that have reshaped industries and opened new markets. For more than a quarter of a century, Foundation Capital has endured, evolved, and thrived through cycles of boom and bust, now managing over $3B in assets with a track record of 34 IPOs and ICOs and 80+ acquisitions. The firm was an early investor in Solana, Algorand, Brave Browser, OpenSea, Stacks, and others.
